claims.citation: New York Herald, 23 July 1866, p. 3, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Steamship City of Limerick (Br), Phillips, Liverpool July
7, with mdse and 204 passengers, to John G Dale. 11th inst.
lat 51 15, lon 20 54, passed a bark rigged steamer, bound E;
14th, lat 49 33, lon 35 44, steamship City of Boston, hence for
Liverpool.
